data.name: TextBox3.Text
data.value: Arrays are like groups of variables that allow you to store sets of similar data A single dimension array is useful for storing and working with a single set of data A multidimensional array can be used to store and work with multiple sets of data Array programming techniques covered Summing and averaging all the elements in an array Summing all the columns in a two-dimensional array Searching an array for a specific value Using parallel arrays

data.name: TextBox1.Text
data.value: An array stores multiple values of same type Like a group of variables with a single name For example, the days of the week might be: A set of 7 string variables With a maximum length of 9 characters All variables within an array are called elements and must be of the same data type You access the elements in an array through a subscript
